conditions.positive_smac_threshold: C(D_star) >= T > 0; otherwise actual full-footprint path must bypass center shortcut
conditions.mppi: C(D_star) >= 1 AND (C(D_star) >= T OR T < 1); consider_footprint=true; actual layer/readback must match
conditions.scope: D_star is maximum center-cell to lethal raster boundary-cell offset for the checker/footprint/yaw lattice. Formula is a gate precondition, not collision proof.
conditions.conservative_vertex_bound: Rc + sqrt(2)*h bounds floor-quantized vertex offsets. It is not a proof for every implementation of line rasterization, unknown/map edges, layer updates or sampled motion.

smac_snapped_16_bin_vertex_sweep.scope: Snapped cell-center and original primitive 16 cardinal/atan headings; not planner replay or proof of internal bin interpolation

finite_sweep.scope: Arbitrary MPPI continuous poses, not Smac snapping

smac_snapped_corner_counterexample.note: Check actual installed mapping separately; no native invocation

counterexample.note: Place a lethal cell at the floor-quantized padded corner. Construct the synthetic raw field by max emitted_cost over that source; not by reverse-mapping OccupancyGrid. Exact installed native result remains to be tested.

decision: Increasing support alone is not a universal discrete gate fix. Use collision eligibility plus exact oriented footprint, retaining narrow-corridor pass. Do not turn circumcircle/inflation into lethal geometry.
